title: Christmas SVG and 3D Crafts Bundle
author: Светлана Зиновьева
description:
Christmas SVG and 3D Crafts Bundle features over 330 elements for your creativity including voluminous Christmas tree decorations, cards, mandalas in the form of snowflakes, Christmas tags, and more.
All files are presented in vector formats and PNG with a transparent background and a resolution of 300 dpi.
This festive bundle includes a large selection of files, which will allow you to cut all the elements in a way convenient for you on most cutting machines.
Get this great bundle for just $12 and save $138!
